title: Objective record
description: One objective of the cascade, one Markdown file per record (objectives/<uid>.md): a strategic (SO), operational (OO), tactical (TO) objective or a tactical task (TT). An SO has no parent; an OO's parent is an SO, a TO's an OO, a TT's a TO (checked by homelabnext.strategy, as are the doctrine rules over its measures). Lifecycle: active -> achieved | retired, only through a strategy-transition intent (the resolution is set by the transition). 2.0 (ADR-0019): a record is identified by its `uid` (a UUIDv7) and names its `type`; every link is a uid; the numbered `id` is gone (the number a record is shown with is computed from type, parent and sibling `order`, never stored). The record-type rules of a link (which types a parent, supports, serves or raised_by may name) are the doctrine's `hierarchy` and `links`, checked by homelabnext.strategy. 1.x records are read only by `hnx records assign-uids`, which migrates them.

parent.description: The uid of the objective one level up (none for an SO; the doctrine's hierarchy names the type).

order.description: Optional: the sort key among its siblings (same type, same parent). Siblings without one follow, in creation (uid) order.

supplemental.description: An objective proposed beyond the baseline cascade (the baseline-SO rule does not count it).

resolution.description: Why it was achieved or retired (set by the transition).

reviews.description: Derived from the review events (homelabnext.reviews); never written in the record file.

uid.description: A record uid: a canonical UUIDv7 (lowercase, version 7), created with the record and never changed (ADR-0019).
